findings.summary: The x axis is labelled and ticked in metres for a quantity that spans 4.8 to 38 mm, so its tick labels read 6x10-3 to 4x10-2 rather than 5 to 40. The repository's plotting rule sizes an SI prefix so tick labels land between about 0.1 and 1000 and puts the prefixed unit in the label; this figure sits an order of magnitude below that floor and needs a mental scale step on every read, which is a legibility cost on the axis that carries the study's independent variable. The fix is local to the drawing script: scale the four spacings to mm (or select the sizes so they read in SI without an exponent) and label the axis 'radial grid spacing [mm]'. Nothing about the data, the fit or the threshold changes, and the SVG must be re-rendered with the script; the figure is cited only in prose, in the fragment's gate section, so no document text depends on the axis number.

rubric_lines: RUBRIC legibility: pass. One series, one fit, one threshold level on log-log axes with both axes named ('band residual / profile current', 'radial grid spacing [m]'); axis labels are 16 pt and tick labels 14 pt, so every label reads at a glance, and the four measured points are individually resolvable at x = 4.77e-3, 9.53e-3, 1.91e-2 and 3.81e-2 m. The story the figure exists to carry is visible without a caption: the two finest grids sit below the 1.0e-3 threshold, the two coarsest above it, and the fit's slope (1.96) is the second-order convergence the plan's done-when claims. Boundary recorded as finding 1: the x quantity spans 4.8 to 38 mm but is labelled and ticked in metres, so the tick labels run 6e-3 to 4e-2 rather than 5 to 40.

RUBRIC data_ink: pass. The measured series is the figure's subject and is drawn as the heaviest mark in it (3.0 pt solid with 5 pt round markers); the fit is 2.4 pt dashed; the threshold is a 1.2 pt dotted level. No gridlines, no fills, no annotation furniture. The only non-data ink is the legend text and the single threshold annotation.

RUBRIC decoration: pass. No gradient, no background fill, no band, no shading, no frame, no dropped shadow, no styling theme. Measured on the render: the outer 4 px frame of the 1399x720 canvas carries exactly zero ink pixels, so nothing is trimmed by a decorative edge either. Spines: only the left (column 103, 639 dark pixels) and bottom (row 641, 1277 dark pixels) axes are drawn; no top or right spine appears anywhere in the dark-row or dark-column tallies, so the panel is properly despined.

RUBRIC contrast: pass. Axis labels and tick labels are near-black on white; the threshold annotation and its dotted level carry the reference grey #929292, which is 3.1:1 against white (relative luminance 0.287) and clears the reference grey the repository's own style names for a limit. The annotation is 14 pt and the measured glyph box is 194 px wide by 16 px tall, so it is comfortably legible.

RUBRIC table_form: pass. Four ladder points of a discretisation study read against a threshold line is a scaling relation, not tabular information: the figure's content is the slope and where the ladder crosses the threshold, and neither survives a table of four numbers. The numerical content is already tabulated beside it in the fragment, so the figure adds the shape rather than duplicating the rows.

RUBRIC label_collision: pass. Measured on the render: no text is clipped (zero ink in the outer 4 px frame), the grey threshold annotation occupies x 264-457, y 63-78, and contains zero data pixels, and it sits 67 px above the dotted level it names (row 145). The legend is frameless and sits in the empty lower-right quadrant, clear of the data, with no label over any other label or over the series. No caption exists for this figure, so no caption-vs-title duplication is possible.
